text.name: Battle of Mogadishu
text.rules: Record "intervention fatigue". SAE spends 1 point. At the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: On 3-4 October 1993 a US raid in Mogadishu, Somalia turned into a day-long battle in which 18 US soldiers were killed; US forces withdrew from Somalia by March 1994.
